topSignals.title: Elcogen and Topsoe both remain silent on company news — 22 days since Elcogen's last post (Sept 21 Metrosert cooperation), 44+ days since Topsoe's last SOFC/SOEC-specific item (Aug 27 H1 results).
topSignals.text: Direct newsroom checks today found no new stack, capacity, or partnership announcement from either priority player. Elcogen News | Topsoe News

topSignals.title: Full benchmark-company rotation completed: today's dedicated searches covered the last seven names on the list (Reverion, Miura, Weichai, Delta Electronics, Shell, Denso, Thermax) — every company on the COMPETITOR BENCHMARK LIST has now had at least one dedicated search this cycle.
topSignals.text: All seven returned only already-logged or multi-year-old history; no new datapoint. See Stack & Cell Technology for detail.

topSignals.title: New: a standing best-in-class benchmark register (SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md) has been seeded from the archive and is now live.
topSignals.text: It tracks ten KPIs (efficiency, degradation, lifetime, capex, manufacturing capacity, largest order, largest funding round, SOEC efficiency) with current-best values, sources and "previous best" tracking. No competitor datapoint found today beat or neared (within ~5%) any seeded value — see LCOE-Relevant Datapoints for the full table reference.

items.text: Elcogen (priority stack):* No new company news. elcogen.com/category/news still shows the Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation post as the latest (22 days old). Recurring "Elcogen launches high-volume SOFC factory" articles resurfaced again in today's search but all trace to the already-logged May 2026 ELCO I Tallinn launch (360 MW/yr) or an earlier 2025-dated version of the same story — not new.

Topsoe (priority stack):* No new company news. topsoe.com/news still shows the H1 2026 results and Uniper e-methanol contract as the most recent dated items. No new SOEC/SOFC test result, factory milestone, or partnership identified.

Rotating benchmark-company dedicated searches (this cycle: Reverion, Miura, Weichai, Delta Electronics, Shell, Denso, Thermax), 7-day lookback — rotation now complete, every listed company has had a dedicated search:
Reverion: No new item beyond the already-logged Sept 29 €150M/$175M Series B and the Sept 18 Doosan $78M SOFC-stack supply contract (reported again today under a rounded figure — not new).
Miura: No 2026 news; results were all the 2024-vintage Miura/Ceres 4.2 kW Japan CHP launch and the related maintenance-network announcement, both already superseded/out of window.

Weichai: No new item; the Ceres/Weichai Chinese manufacturing-licence deal and today's recirculated "Ceres shares soar on China data centre power deal" headline both trace to the same already-logged July 2026 announcement.
Delta Electronics: No 2026 news; only the 2024 Ceres-Delta hydrogen technology licence resurfaced.
Shell: No new SOFC-specific item; results were the existing Shell/Doosan/Hyundai maritime SOFC development project (already on file) and unrelated 2025-dated SEO aggregator content.
Denso: No new item; only 2025-vintage SEO aggregator "strategy" pieces, no primary-source 2026 announcement.
Thermax: No English or Indian-market news located in the lookback window.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin):* No new stack/cell-technology-specific announcements beyond items already logged (financial/market news for Bloom, FCEL and Ceres covered below). Sunfire's SOEC test facility at BASF Schwarzheide (groundbreaking Aug 19, up to 89% LHV efficiency target, commissioning end 2026) remains the most recent genuinely new stack-adjacent item on file — unchanged since last reported.
